correspondences.notes: BIDS 1.11.2 has no FreeSurfer longitudinal layout.

brainlife.desc: FreeSurfer longitudinal base: the within-subject template subject directory plus the mri/ files of each timepoint used to build it.
brainlife.name: neuro/freesurfer/longitudinal-template

original.desc: Freesurfer longitudinal base template and mri/ files for each timepoints used to generate the template

brainlife.readme:
Run freesurfer

**Use for:** Step 2 of FreeSurfer longitudinal processing and longitudinal statistics.

**Not for:** Cross-sectional analysis; use the per-timepoint neuro/freesurfer outputs.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 3 (directly identifiable or traceable) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 2 Apps, output of 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.freesurfer.longitudinal-template.json

files.desc: mri/ files of each cross-sectional timepoint used for the template.

identifying_risks: Template and timepoint mri/ volumes keep the face of the input T1w
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 5: contains recognisable facial anatomy from the input T1w images.
sharing_cautions: Deface or strip whole-head volumes before sharing
tier_conditions: Tier 2 when inputs were defaced, or after removing whole-head volumes

inputs_of.name: Freesurfer 7.1.1 Longitudinal (Step 2/2)
inputs_of.purpose: runs FreeSurfer 7.1.1 recon-all -long on one timepoint against the longitudinal base template from Step 1/2

intended_use: Step 2 of FreeSurfer longitudinal processing and longitudinal statistics.
not_suitable_for: Cross-sectional analysis; use the per-timepoint neuro/freesurfer outputs.
